nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a Finsler metric on a manifold $M$. The forward Finsler distance from $x \in M$ to $y \in M$ is the value in $[0, \infty]$
nodes.title: Forward Finsler distance

nodes.summary: For every finite-dimensional real inner product space $V$, the Euclidean Finsler metric $F(x, v) = \|v\|$ on $V$ is reversible: $F(x, -v) = F(x, v)$ for all $x, v \in V$.
nodes.title: The Euclidean Finsler metric is reversible

nodes.summary: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, viewed as a smooth manifold whose tangent spaces are $V$ itself. The Euclidean Finsler metric on $V$ is $F(x, v) = \|v\|$ for $x \in V$ and $v \in T_xV = V$.
nodes.title: Euclidean Finsler metric

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a $C^\infty$ manifold (possibly with boundary or corners) modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space $E$, so that each tangent space $T_xM$ is $E$. A $C^\infty$ Finsler metric on $M$ is a continuous function $F : TM \to \mathbb{R}$ that is $C^\infty$ off the zero section, satisfies $F(x, v) > 0$ for every $x \in M$ and every nonzero $v \in T_xM$, is positively homogeneous of degree one on each…
nodes.title: Finsler metric

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a Finsler metric on a manifold $M$. A curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to M$ is a closed geodesic of $F$ if it is a geodesic of $F$, it is periodic with some period $T > 0$, that is $\gamma(t + T) = \gamma(t)$ for all real $t$, and it is not constant: $\gamma(t_1) \ne \gamma(t_2)$ for some real $t_1, t_2$.
nodes.title: Closed Finsler geodesic

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a Finsler metric on a manifold $M$ with forward distance $d_F$, let $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to M$ be a curve, let $s \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ be a set of times and let $c \ge 0$ be a real number. Then $\gamma$ is a geodesic of speed $c$ of $F$ on $s$ if for every $t \in s$ there is $\varepsilon > 0$ such that $d_F(\gamma(t_1), \gamma(t_2)) = c\,(t_2 - t_1)$ for all $t_1, t_2 \in s$ with $t_1 \le t_2$,…
nodes.title: Finsler geodesic of given speed on a set of times

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a Finsler metric on a manifold $M$. A curve $\gamma : \mathbb{R} \to M$ is a geodesic of $F$ if there is a real number $c \ge 0$ such that $\gamma$ is a geodesic of speed $c$ of $F$ on all of $\mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Finsler geodesic

nodes.summary: A Finsler metric $F$ on a manifold $M$ is reversible if $F(x, -v) = F(x, v)$ for every point $x \in M$ and every tangent vector $v \in T_xM$.
nodes.title: Reversible Finsler metric

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
